metadata.name: Wearly Knowledge Graph
metadata.description: Three-layer structured-knowledge graph modeling Wearly's domain rules, user behavior, and runtime archetypes. Distinct from the Learning Graph (reader concepts) and the Reasoning Graph (one-recommendation explanation).

metrics.summary: Three skin-tone palettes inform the score.
Base 60, +8 best / +4 good / -10 avoid, clamped to 0-100.
Unknown skin tone returns a neutral score with a clear note.
Body-positive language is a contract; styling reasoning frames features as honored, not as targets for change.
Fit-profile fields are optional; missing fields skip the note.
Measurement-derived profile suggestions are preference-based, never prescriptive — user opts in, body-positive language only.
Map free-text occasion to one of five canonical tags.
Required piece-types per occasion drive the gap check.
Dress-vs-separates branching for formal and dinner occasions.
Accessory cap of two.
A required piece-type missing from the outfit is a gap.
Cold weather without occasion-matching outerwear is a gap.
Suggestions are descriptive (never promotional).
Tone: 'would round out your wardrobe', not 'you need'.
Combined occasion-tag + season filter.
Items in rejected_ids are excluded from candidate pools.
Freshness score is a tie-breaker with a 0.4 floor.
Recently-worn pieces get a transparent reasoning note.
Temperature bands map to layer advice.
Outerwear is injected only when temp < 60 F and an occasion-matching outer piece exists.
On weather-fetch failure, fall back to a seasonal estimate.
